States' 41% share of the divisible pool. Unconditional — the constitutional floor. Cesses are EXCLUDED from this pool.
Finance Commission grants (revenue-deficit, sector, disaster). Disbursed from the Union side as 3601.
Centrally Sponsored Schemes. THE throttled channel: just-in-time, UC-gated, float held in CFI, routed RBI->SNA bypassing the state treasury (fund_flow_map §2).
Central Sector schemes via a Central Nodal Agency. Endpoint may be a ULB/PRI/agency; modelled to ulb here as a common case.
Union loans/back-to-back (e.g. GST-comp 2020-21). 7601 from the Union side; state receives under 6004.
Central Finance Commission local-body grants (tied + untied), now conditioned on audited accounts / property-tax floors. Applies to pri too.

State->local-body assignments & compensation land under 3604 'Compensation and Assignments to Local Bodies and Panchayati Raj Institutions' (NOT 3601, which is Union->State grants). Scheme grants also flow via sector heads (2217 urban dev).
State->PRI assignments & compensation under 3604; scheme grants via 2515 (rural dev). 3601 is Union->State, not this.
State->city compensation for abolished octroi. AMC's largest 'from above' line. The three-tier worked example.
